handoff: Approve: no blocking findings. AC1–AC7 are met with tests at S1 and the pinned suites; the golden diff is exactly the command rename; the removed-verb check covers stdout and stderr of every cli suite command; help tiers and story groups are as specified. AC8 (live paste) is left for QA. Minor: the agent preamble stays above the tiers (AC4 says 'then', B1 says 'as today'; a person to confirm), port and schema doc strings still name old verbs, noun groups can silently drop an unlisted verb, plugins/herdr next.sh and pick.sh still call 'norn cockpit' (slice 15, same release).

findings.title: Agent preamble printed before the tiers, not after
findings.detail:
AC4: 'Core …, Agent protocol …, then the agent preamble and skills list'. The preamble stays under the title, as before. B1 says 'followed by the agent preamble and the skills list as today', so keeping today's position is defensible. The implementer chose it deliberately (see handoff).
Axis: spec
Suggestion: A person confirms the placement at QA; amend AC4/B1 wording in slice 15 if it is kept.

findings.title: Contract doc strings still name removed verbs
findings.detail:
ports.ts:528 gives 'norn answer gh-123/03 …' as an example of the inbox command field. Schema titles and descriptions say 'norn workflow' (schema/src/workflow.ts:181), 'norn trace event' (trace.ts:274) and 'norn open inbox items' (local.ts:82), and these are emitted into packages/schema/json. None of them is a printed command.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Update with the slice 15 docs sweep (or here, with schema:emit).

findings.title: Noun groups silently drop verbs that are not listed or are misspelled
findings.detail:
formatNounHelp maps group names through byName(name) ?? []. A typo in Noun.groups, or a verb added to the noun but not to any group, disappears from `norn story` with no failure. No test checks that the groups cover the noun's verbs exactly.
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Add a test (or an assertion at registry build) that the groups list every verb of the noun exactly once.

findings.title: JSON tiers omit the 'Other' tier formatHelp prints
findings.detail:
The tree is built from HELP_GROUPS only, while formatHelp prints ungrouped commands under 'Other'. Today every command is grouped, so the two agree, but they can drift. Group titles are also stored lowercase and capitalised at render (help.ts:120).
Axis: standards
Suggestion: Derive text and JSON from one tier list.

findings.title: Herdr plugin scripts still call the removed `norn cockpit`
findings.detail:
plugins/herdr/next.sh and pick.sh call `norn cockpit`, which is now an unknown command. The plugin is out of scope here (slice 15, B8), but it must ship in the same release.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Make sure slice 15 covers plugins/herdr.
